content_sections.heading: Maharashtra State Security Corporation Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Maharashtra State Security Corporation (Maharashtra Rajya Suraksha Mahamandal), a statutory corporation of the Government of Maharashtra
Security Supervisory Officer (SSO): Retd. ACP, Retd. PI, Retd. PSI
Rs. 50,000 (Retd. ACP); Rs. 45,000 (Retd. PI); Rs. 35,000 (Retd. PSI)
Retd. ACP and Retd. PI: degree in any discipline; Retd. PSI: 12th pass
Mahamumbai Division (Mumbai City, Mumbai Suburban) and Konkan Division
In person or by post, on the prescribed application form
27 November 2026, up to 18.00 hours (the notice does not say whether this is for receipt or dispatch)

content_sections.heading: About the Corporation
content_sections.text: The notice describes Maharashtra State Security Corporation as the Government of Maharashtra's statutory corporation. It provides security guards, for a fee, to government and other industrial and commercial establishments in the state and in the Mumbai metropolitan region. The Corporation's office is at Centre-1, 32nd Floor, World Trade Center, Cuff Parade, Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice says the application may be submitted in person or sent by post to this address: Police Director General and Managing Director, Maharashtra State Security Corporation, Centre-1, 32nd Floor, World Trade Center, Cuff Parade, Mumbai - 400 005. Telephone: (022) 69965555. The notice does not name a postal mode, such as speed post or registered post, or any wording for the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The 3 posts are divided between two divisions as follows. Retd. ACP: officer retired from the post of Police Commissioner / Deputy Superintendent of Police (armed / unarmed) from the Maharashtra State Police or the State Reserve Police Force, with a degree in any discipline from a recognised university. Retd. PI: officer retired from the post of Police Inspector (armed / unarmed) from the Maharashtra State Police or the State Reserve Police Force, with a degree in any discipline from a recognised university. Retd. PSI: officer retired from the post of Police Sub-Inspector (armed / unarmed) from the Maharashtra State Police or the State Reserve Police Force, with the 12th standard passed. For each post, preference goes to candidates who live in the respective area and served in the police department there. The age of the candidate should not be more than 61 years on 30 November 2026. The notice prints the same limit for all three posts and lists no age relaxation. The notice mentions no experience requirement beyond the retirement rank. For the discipline-specific details of each post, candidates should see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Maharashtra State Security Corporation Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these rights, duties and responsibilities for the Security Supervisory Officer post. It prints one list for all the posts. Supervise and control, day to day, the Corporation's security guards deployed at establishments, and bear the responsibility for the establishment's security and protection. Keep the security guards alert as per the possible threats to the establishment and get work done from them efficiently. Report to the head office about giving appreciation certificates or rewards to security guards who work well. Submit to the head office the reports of guards who are negligent in duty, before inquiry action. Take the daily attendance of the security guards and record it in the HRMS system. Get the weapons of the security guards maintained and repaired through the armourer. Take action to recover the security fee from establishments on time, and coordinate with the establishment and the head office on difficulties to recover pending dues. Do the related work assigned by the head office. Work as per orders given from time to time by the Managing Director and other senior officers.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The documents named in the notice for the interview are: Personal information (bio-data) Educational documents Retirement certificate / retirement identity card Copy of the pension book Photo / PAN card / Aadhaar card ACR of the last five years The application form also asks for the full name as in the service record, date of birth, addresses, mobile number, email id, date of joining police, date of retirement, last basic pay drawn, educational qualifications, details of postings in the last 15 years, rewards, punishments, pending departmental enquiries, details of criminal cases, and a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates are shortlisted from the applications and called for interview. A list of candidates will be prepared on the basis of the interview, experience and similar factors. Appointment will be considered in the order of merit in this list, as vacancies are available in the Corporation. Candidates who meet the minimum qualification will be told the interview time and date by phone. Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense. When they come, they must bring the retirement identity card, pension book and the originals of the educational documents, along with the bio-data and 2 attested copies.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Maharashtra State Security Corporation Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 Security Supervisory Officer posts: 1 Retd. ACP, 1 Retd. PI and 1 Retd. PSI.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application period ends on 27 November 2026 at 18.00 hours. It began on 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Security Supervisory Officer posts?
faq.answer: Retd. ACP and Retd. PI officers need a degree in any discipline from a recognised university. Retd. PSI officers need the 12th standard passed. All must have retired from the respective rank in the Maharashtra State Police or the State Reserve Police Force.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age should not be more than 61 years on 30 November 2026. The notice gives no minimum age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: The notice gives Rs. 50,000 for Retd. ACP, Rs. 45,000 for Retd. PI and Rs. 35,000 for Retd. PSI.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed application format and submit it in person or send it by post to the Police Director General and Managing Director, Maharashtra State Security Corporation, Centre-1, 32nd Floor, World Trade Center, Cuff Parade, Mumbai - 400 005.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates are called for interview. A list is prepared on the interview, experience and similar factors, and appointment is considered in merit order in that list.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on a contract basis for 11 months. Re-appointment may be given depending on the Corporation's need and the employee's capacity, knowledge and other criteria.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets preference?
faq.answer: Preference goes to candidates who live in the respective area and served in the police department there.

faq.question: Q10. Who pays the cost of attending the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must attend the interview at their own expense.
